item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya sets up a simple circuit on her study table at home using one cell, a switch, and a torch bulb, connected in a single loop with wires. The picture shows the actual circuit she built.

She now wants to draw a circuit diagram of it using standard symbols. Which statement about her circuit diagram is correct?

options.A: The bulb can be drawn as any neat sketch of a lamp, because a circuit diagram is just a tidy picture of the parts.
options.B: Each component must be drawn with its standard symbol: the cell with a long and a short line, the switch as an open or closed gap, and the bulb as a circle with a cross inside.
options.C: The cell symbol can be drawn with the long and short lines either way round, because the orientation of the cell does not matter.
options.D: The wires must be drawn curved around the bulb exactly as they lie on the table, so the diagram matches the real circuit's shape.
